blocks.text: Model banne ke baad dekhna zaroori hai ke woh kitna achha chalta hai aur us ke nataij ka matlab kya hai; isi ko model evaluation kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Statistical modelling mein model evaluation ka tasawwur samjhaiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Evaluation train shuda model ko anadekhe data par aazmata hai ta ke pata chale ke us ki pesh-goi aitbaar ke qabil hai. Error metrics naapte hain ke andaza asal se kitna door hai (stall model ki 28 customers par 30 rupay ki ghalti); accuracy metrics ginte hain ke haan ya nahi wale andaze kitni baar durust hain (pass ya fail). Phir nataij samjhe jate, insaf, bias aur privacy jaanche jate, aur kharab kaarkardagi par zyada data ya behtar awamil se model behtar kiya jata hai.

items: Model evaluation: naye data par aazmana, error aur accuracy naapna, samajhna, akhlaqiyat jaanchna.
